name: generation
description: Drafts novel hypotheses from a research goal

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Search arXiv literature or retrieve a paper's full text. Use mode='search' with a query to find relevant papers (returns title, abstract, authors, year, arxiv_id). Use mode='fetch' with an arxiv_id to retrieve the full paper in markdown.

mode.description: Operation: 'search' finds papers, 'fetch' retrieves full text

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (mode=search)

max_results.description: Number of results per page (mode=search, default 5, max 20)

page.description: Zero-based page number for pagination (mode=search, default 0)

hypotheses.description: Candidate hypotheses generated from the research goal

rationale.description: Mechanistic or theoretical reasoning behind the hypothesis

testable_predictions.description: Concrete, falsifiable predictions that can be experimentally verified

statement.description: Concise one- or two-sentence statement of the hypothesis

proposed_experiment.description: A concrete experimental design to validate this hypothesis
